sources.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro Tech Blog: Advancing Open Intelligence
sources.snippet: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro, our most capable 3T-class open-weight model with 1M-token context and major advances in coding, 3D modeling, and financial research.

sources.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro: Specs, Price, Open Weights, and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Moonshot released Kimi K3.1 Pro on October 23 at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output, a third less than Kimi K3, and published the open weights on November 4 under the Kimi K3.1 Pro License. Specs, pricing, the model card, Moonshot's benchmark claims, and what it means for the hardware.
